examples.knowledge_point: Finding the Image of a Vector Under a Linear Transformation Given its Standard Matrix
examples.problem:
Consider the matrix $T$ and the vector $\mathbf{v}$ given below. If $T$ is the standard matrix of the linear transformation $\mathbf{T},$ find $\mathbf{T}(\mathbf{v}).$

$$
[\begin{aligned}4 & 7 \\ -6 & -2\end{aligned}]
$$
examples.worked_solution:
Using the fact that $\,\mathbf{T}(\mathbf{v})=T\cdot \mathbf{v},$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}T(v) & =T\cdot v \\  & =[\begin{aligned}4 & 7 \\ -6 & -2\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 5\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}27 \\ 2\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

feedback.problem:
What is the linear transformation $T$ whose standard matrix is $T=[\begin{aligned}0 & 5 \\ -2 & 7\end{aligned}]?$

  

| $T:[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]⟶\,\,$ |  | {{field-1}} |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
|  | {{field-2}} |  |  |
feedback.worked_solution:
Consider a general vector $\,[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}].$ Multiplying by the matrix $T,$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}T\cdot [\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}0 & 5 \\ -2 & 7\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}5y \\ -2x+7y\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the linear transformation $\,T\,$ is given by

$$
T:[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]⟶[\begin{aligned}5y \\ -2x+7y\end{aligned}].
$$
